verdict.rationale: Unity's docs confirm a Package Manager and Asset Database system that delivers 'a wide range of enhancements' and manages imported assets, supporting the general claim of an extensible asset/tool ecosystem (unity-docs-12, unity-docs-13, unity-docs-29). However, there is no first-party evidence quantifying the Asset Store's size or breadth, and community evidence shows real friction with the Store (Unity banning a legitimate open-source plugin developer, contradictory answers, bad faith) which undercuts the 'ready-made' ecosystem experience for some publishers (unity-comm-7, unity-comm-8). missing for 10: explicit Asset Store scale/stats, independent corroboration of asset quality/breadth, resolution of the described publisher-relations friction.
